items.title: Marian McPartland — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: A pop singer, like probably the Diana Ross of her day.

ctx.x: Wow. Tell the listeners who Elizabeth Welsh was. Was she a vocalist or . . .

Elizabeth Welsh was a very . . . I guess she had gone to England from America. She was a very fine singer. A pop singer, like probably the Diana Ross of her day. And of course Adelaide Hall I think is well known to all jazz people.
Didn’t Art Tatum accompany her at one . . .
